greeting: Hi {name}, I'm Stack Updater! 👋 Your bot is almost ready... Give me a moment to complete the configuration...
install_complete: Installation complete 🎉 {name}, I'm now at your service. Together we can: • Update your Linux system • Update Docker containers, together or individually • Reboot the system • Change the monthly reminder schedule Type /start to begin. 📅 The reminder is set for day {day} of every month at {hour}:{minute}.
main_menu: Hey {name}! I'm here to help you manage your server. What are we doing today?
updates_menu: 🛠️ Service Management From here you can update the OS, manage your Docker containers or update everything at once.
system_menu_title: 🖥️ System Here you can update system packages, check hardware resources (CPU, RAM and disks) or reboot the machine when needed.
system_info_uptodate: ✅ System is already up to date. No packages to install.
system_confirm: 🖥️ Confirm System Update Are you sure you want to update the system? {count} packages will be installed.
containers_list_title: 🐳 Docker Containers Select a container to manage it individually, or update them all in one go.
container_detail_title: 🐳 Container: {name} Image: {image} Tag: {tag} Status: {status}{extra} What would you like to do?
confirm_start_container: Are you sure you want to start container {name}?
confirm_restart_container: Are you sure you want to restart container {name}?
confirm_stop_container: Are you sure you want to stop container {name}?
confirm_down_container: Are you sure you want to remove container {name}?
confirm_update_container: Are you sure you want to update container {name}?
confirm_update_all_containers: Are you sure you want to update all containers?
confirm_update_all: Are you sure you want to update both the system and containers?
confirm_reboot: ⚡ Reboot System Are you sure you want to reboot the machine?
step_pull_no_updates: • ✅ All images were already up to date
autoremove_prompt: ⚠️ No longer needed packages ({count}): {packages} Do you want to remove them?
full_upgrade_prompt: ⚠️ {count} package(s) cannot be upgraded with standard upgrade (held back). Do you want to run a full upgrade?
reboot_bye: 🔄 Rebooting the system… I'll be back shortly.
reboot_done: ✅ System rebooted successfully! 😊 I'm back and ready. What are we doing now?
